name: Neritic-Shoal
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a tidally locked hemisphere, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on carbon, nitrogen and dark crystals are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
